announcements.text: Raytheon Co., Woburn, Massachusetts is being awarded a contract modification (P00038) under a previously awarded indefinite-delivery/indefinite-quantity contract HQ0147-18-D-0001. This modification provides for a non-competitive, two-year extension and increases the contract ceiling from $2,605,033,000 to $2,999,033,000. The current contract was the result of a sole-source acquisition. Under this contract extension, Raytheon will continue operations and sustainment support for the Army Navy/Transportable Radar Surveillance and Control Model 2 (AN/TPY-2) radar systems, utilizing a combination of cost-plus-incentive-fee, cost-plus-fixed-fee, and firm-fixed-price contract line items. Associated task order extensions reflecting the increase are also being awarded. The work will be performed in Woburn, Massachusetts, and at multiple radar sites inside and outside of the continental U.S. The contract modification will extend the current ordering period an additional two years from Oct. 31, 2026, to Oct. 31, 2028. Fiscal 2027 operations and maintenance, research, development, test and evaluation, and procurement funds totaling $112,309,403 will be obligated at the time of award via task order modification. The Missile Defense Agency, Redstone Arsenal, Alabama, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory LLC, Laurel, Maryland, is awarded a $47,738,983 hybrid cost-plus-fixed-fee and cost-no-fee contract (N0003027C3002). Tasks to be performed include research and development support services for the Undersea Security Program investigating present and future technological and operational vulnerabilities impacting submarines and other assets used in Subsea and Seabed Warfare. Work will be performed in Laurel, Maryland (80%); and Washington, D.C. (20%), with an expected completion date of Oct. 20, 2031. Fiscal 2026 research, development, test, and evaluation funds in the amount of $50,000 will be obligated at the time of award. These funds will expire at the end of the current fiscal year. This contract was awarded under full and open competition as a result of a Broad Agency Announcement pursuant to 10 U.S. Code 4001(c)(1) and was previously synopsized on the System for Award Management (SAM.gov) online portal. Portfolio Acquisition Executive Strategic Systems Programs, Washington, D.C., is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: MW Services Inc.,* Temecula, California, has been awarded a $10,000,000 ceiling increase modification (P00006) to previously awarded contract FA4661-23-D-0001 for broad-range maintenance, repair, and minor construction projects. This modification will increase the contract value from $20,000,000 to $30,000,000. Work will be performed at Dyess Air Force Base, Texas, and is expected to be completed by March 15, 2027. No funds are being obligated at the time of award. The 7th Contracting Squadron, Dyess AFB, Texas, is the contracting activity.

announcements.text: Kwaan RB Construction and Facility Services LLC,* Kake, Alaska, has been awarded a $9,930,572 firm-fixed-price contract for base operations and facility maintenance. This contract provides for the maintenance and repair of Tinker Air Force Base facilities and infrastructure. Work will be performed at Tinker AFB, Oklahoma, and is expected to be completed by Oct. 11, 2027. This contract was an 8(a) sole-source acquisition. Fiscal 2026 operations and maintenance funds in the amount of $9,930,572 are being obligated at the time of award. The Air Force Sustainment Center, Tinker AFB, Oklahoma, is the contracting activity (FA8137-26-C-0006). (Awarded on Sep. 30, 2026).
